questions.question: On this day in 1974, a famous interstellar radio signal carrying information about Earth and humanity was transmitted into space from which territory?
questions.explanation: The Arecibo message was broadcast from the Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico towards the star cluster Messier 13 on 16 November 1974.
questions.context:
On this day in 1974: The Arecibo message is broadcast from Puerto Rico.
Arecibo message (Radio message sent into space in 1974): The Arecibo message is an interstellar radio message carrying basic information about humanity and Earth that was sent to the globular cluster Messier 13 (M13) in 1974.

questions.question: In sci-fi survival film The End of Oak Street, written and directed by David Robert Mitchell, a suburban neighbourhood is transported back in time to which era?
questions.explanation: The movie centres on a family whose suburban street is displaced from 1982 into prehistoric times among dinosaurs.
questions.context: The End of Oak Street (2026 film by David Robert Mitchell): The End of Oak Street is a 2026 American science fiction survival film written, co-produced, and directed by David Robert Mitchell and starring Anne Hathaway, Ewan McGregor, Maisy Stella, and Christian Convery with supporting roles done by Jordan Alexa Davis, P. J. Byrne and Emily Kuroda. It tells the story of a family whose suburban neighborhood has been transported from 1982 into the age of dinosaurs.

questions.question: Which English performer, who achieved three number-one solo singles in the UK between 1982 and 1990, originally came to prominence as the drummer for the rock band Genesis?
questions.explanation: Phil Collins served as the drummer and main vocalist for Genesis before achieving huge success as a solo artist.
questions.context: Phil Collins (English musician (born 1951)): Philip David Charles Collins is an English singer, drummer, songwriter, record producer, and actor. He is best known as the drummer and later lead vocalist of the rock band Genesis, and for his highly successful career as a solo artist. Between 1982 and 1990, Collins achieved three UK and seven US number-one singles as a solo performer.

questions.question: Which fictional persona co-created by stand-up comedian John Mulaney and Bill Hader featured regularly during Mulaney's time writing for Saturday Night Live?
questions.explanation: During his tenure as a writer on Saturday Night Live from 2008 to 2013, John Mulaney co-created the popular recurring character Stefon with Bill Hader.
questions.context: John Mulaney (American comedian, actor, and writer (born 1982)): John Edmund Mulaney is an American stand-up comedian, actor, writer, and producer. Born and raised in Chicago, Illinois, Mulaney first rose to prominence for his work as a writer for the NBC sketch comedy series Saturday Night Live from 2008 to 2013, where he contributed to numerous sketches and characters, including Stefon, a recurring character whom he and Bill Hader co-created.

questions.question: Who made history as the first female athlete to win both an Olympic gold medal in judo and a UFC championship title?
questions.explanation: Kayla Harrison achieved the unprecedented feat of capturing both an Olympic gold medal in judo and a championship in the UFC.
questions.context: Kayla Harrison (American Olympic judoka and mixed martial artist (born 1990)): Kayla Jean Harrison is an American professional mixed martial artist and former judoka. She currently competes in the women's Bantamweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where she is the current UFC Women's Bantamweight Champion. She is the first female fighter to win an Olympic gold medal and a UFC championship. She is also a former two-time Professional Fighters League lightweight champion. As of November 18, 2025, she is #2 in the UFC women's pound-for-pound rankings.
